subject: Acme MAP: post-call recap & mutual action plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@acme.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Acme MAP: post-call recap & next steps

Hi Claire -

Thanks again for your time this afternoon. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so we have alignment on pains, goals, stakeholders, and next steps. Please reply with any edits and confirm owners/dates so we can lock the plan in.

Key pains discussed:
- Latency variability on peak queries impacting customer experience (~500-1200ms spikes).
- Token costs at scale for contextualized chat flows.
- Compliance: need per-request audit logs and customer data residency for EU customers.

Primary goals:
- Reduce 95th percentile latency to <400ms for typical queries by Q4.
- Lower per-conversation token cost by ~25% via batching + caching.
- Achieve evidence for SOC 2 controls and provide audit log exports for procurement.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (draft):
1) Technical evaluation (POC) - Redwood supplies a small MAP PoC: dedicated model profile + telemetry for two representative flows.
   - Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole
   - Owner (Acme): Claire Thompson
   - Target: Kickoff by 2026-09-20, complete by 2026-09-30

2) Procurement & Security review
   - Owner (Acme): Procurement (Susan Lee) + InfoSec (Patrick O'Neill)
   - Owner (Redwood): Logan Wright (security lead) + Rishi Malhotra (contracts)
   - Target: Procurement terms & SOC 2 evidence exchange by 2026-10-07

3) Pilot / performance validation
   - Owner (Acme): Engineering lead (TBD)
   - Owner (Redwood): Marissa + platform team
   - Target: Pilot run 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-15; decisions on roll/scale by 2026-10-20

4) Exec decision & contract signature
   - Decision by Acme exec sponsor
   - Target date: 2026-10-01 (preferred) - flexible based on procurement timeline

Notes & asks:
- Can you confirm the Acme exec sponsor and procurement contact? I listed Susan Lee and Patrick O'Neill based on our call but please correct.
- Attached: short one-pager PoC scope and expected deliverables (redwood-map-poc.pdf).
- Link to shared MAP doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MAP-recap

If this looks good I will update the MAP with exact owners and push a HubSpot record for tracking.

Thanks - looking forward to moving fast on this.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: redwood-map-poc.pdf (1 page)]

Subject: Re: Acme MAP: post-call recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa - this is great and mostly aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications and minor updates: 

- Procurement contact is Susan Lee (cc'd). InfoSec is Patrick O'Neill (cc'd) and they'll need SOC 2 evidence + a short architecture diagram for our security review.
- Exec sponsor will be me, but I'll loop in VP of Product (Patricia Gomez) once we have the pilot results - she will own the final decision.
- Can we shift the procurement target to 2026-10-10? Our legal bucket is a bit backlogged the first week of October.

One more ask: please include an estimated cost delta for the pilot (expected monthly spend and a rough per-token cost if possible) so procurement can triage budget.

I'll review the attached PoC doc and provide feedback by tomorrow EOD.

Thanks,
Claire Thompson

Updated MAP (high level):
1) Technical evaluation (PoC)
   - Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole
   - Owner (Acme): Claire Thompson
   - Dates: 2026-09-20 to 2026-09-30
   - Success criteria: 95p latency reduction measured on representative flow; telemetry dashboard available; functional audit logs exported

2) Procurement & Security review
   - Owner (Acme): Susan Lee (procurement), Patrick O'Neill (InfoSec)
   - Owner (Redwood): Logan Wright (security lead), Rishi Malhotra (legal/contracts)
   - Dates: target completion by 2026-10-10 (per Claire)

3) Pilot / performance validation
   - Dates: 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-15
   - Decision milestone: 2026-10-20 (go/no-go for scale)

4) Exec decision & signature
   - Target decision date: 2026-10-20 (flexible)

Estimated pilot budget (ballpark):
- Expected spend for pilot window: $8k- $12k (depends on traffic profile and model selection)
- Per-token guidance: expect ~25% savings vs current baseline with batching + KV cache in pilot; will provide specific per-token numbers in the PoC telemetry report

Attachments:
- redwood-mutex-map.xlsx (MAP tracker)
- redwood-map-poc.pdf (PoC scope supplied earlier)

Related links:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.redwood.com/deals/ACME-2026-042

Next steps:
- I will: 1) Share the tracker and PoC environment details by Monday 2026-09-20; 2) start provisioning the PoC instance (we'll need 1-2 engineer touchpoints from Acme during setup).
- Claire: confirm exec sponsor (noted) and procurement contact (Susan confirmed).

If that timeline works I'll lock dates in HubSpot and send calendar invites.

Best,
